propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON in a model reply, allowing quoted examples or tool results to masquerade as the real payload instead of the actual schema contract
Schema-blind extraction has recurred five times across model swaps and provider cutoffs, defeating prior instance-level fixes
Prompted structured output must be hardened with schema-filtered candidate selection using last-valid-wins semantics and an explicit sentinel output channel before provider-native solutions are safe
Bedrock native structured output (outputConfig) requires SDK floor of botocore >= 1.43 and measured per-model thinking-compatibility gating instead of blanket feature detection
An opt-in replayable raw-reply artifact on parse failure and a deterministic before/after evaluation harness are required to measure and validate the fix across the provider matrix
